samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Converts a serial input signal into a parallel output signal after receiving 8 bits.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="WIDTH" value="8">Width of the parallel output.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width="4">4-bit counter to track the number of bits received.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_reg" width="8">Register to hold the parallel output data.</reg>
        <wire id="dout_valid_int">Internal wire for dout_valid.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'b0;
                dout_reg <= 8'b0;
                dout_valid_int <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (din_valid && cnt < WIDTH) begin
                    dout_reg[cnt] <= din_serial;
                    cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                end
                if (cnt == WIDTH) begin
                    dout_valid_int <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    dout_valid_int <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
        assign dout_parallel = dout_reg;
        assign dout_valid = dout_valid_int;
    </implementation>
</module>
